common.tagline: Find work today. Get paid today.

home.heroSubtitle: Find a job or post one — no waiting around.
home.step1Body: A recruiter posts a job, a worker finds it in seconds.
home.step2Body: The right profile is suggested based on distance, skills and rating.
home.step3Body: Funds are held in escrow and released once the job is done.
home.forWorkersBody: Find jobs near you and get paid without waiting.
home.forWorkersPoint1: Verified jobs, payment guaranteed by escrow
home.forWorkersPoint2: Choose your hours, accept what suits you
home.forWorkersPoint3: Build your reputation with verified reviews
home.forEmployersBody: Quickly hire reliable people for your one-off needs.
home.forEmployersPoint1: Verified profiles, rated by the community
home.forEmployersPoint2: Secure payment, released only when you approve
home.forEmployersPoint3: Post a job in under 2 minutes
home.categoriesBody: A preview of the categories available on the platform.
home.trustEscrowBody: Money is held as soon as it's accepted and released only once the job is confirmed.
home.trustKycBody: Profiles can be verified (ID document) for extra safety on both sides.
home.trustSupportBody: A team handles disputes and answers questions quickly.
home.statPaymentLabel: as soon as the job is confirmed
home.statSupportLabel: a team reachable if something goes wrong
home.testimonial1Quote: I found a delivery job that same morning and got paid that evening. Simple and fast.
home.testimonial2Quote: Posting a job takes two minutes and I got serious applications right away.
home.testimonial3Quote: The escrow reassures both sides: no one gets paid or shortchanged before the work is done.
home.faq1Q: How do I get paid after a job?
home.faq1A: As soon as the recruiter confirms the job is done, the funds already held in escrow are transferred to your QuickJob wallet.
home.faq2Q: What happens if there's a disagreement?
home.faq2A: The payment stays held in escrow and our support team steps in to review the situation and decide.
home.faq3A: Yes, creating a worker or recruiter account is free. A clear commission only applies to paid jobs.
home.faq4Q: Which cities or countries is QuickJob available in?
home.faq4A: QuickJob is built to work anywhere: each market (country, currency, language) is configured without changing the app.
home.faq5Q: Do I need to verify my identity to use QuickJob?
home.faq5A: It's not required to get started, but identity verification builds trust and may be requested for certain jobs.
home.ctaMidBody: Thousands of jobs are waiting, or post yours in a few minutes.
home.ctaBottomBody: Whether you're looking for work or hiring, get started in minutes.

about.value1Body: Escrow payment, verifiable profiles, authentic reviews.
about.value2Body: No geographic, monetary or language barrier hardcoded in.

about.contactBody: A question, an issue? Write to us, our team replies quickly.
